steps.title: Configure Project Environment
steps.description: Establish target SDK 34, compile SDK 34, and configure AGP 8.3.2 with Gradle 8.5 for the Camera Pro app build.

steps.title: Define Android Permissions & Hardware Requirements
steps.description: Add camera permissions and camera feature declarations to the AndroidManifest.xml file.

steps.title: Design Shutter Button Drawable
steps.description: Create a custom shape XML drawable for a beautiful outer circular camera shutter action button.

steps.title: Design Styled Button Background
steps.description: Create a translucent rounded background for the camera switch and flash toggle buttons.

steps.title: Design Camera Layout with Fullscreen Preview & Overlays
steps.description: Develop XML layout featuring a SurfaceView for camera stream, flash/switch controls, custom shutter, preview thumbnail, and fullscreen image overlay.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity and Handles Runtime Permissions
steps.description: Request runtime camera access permission at startup and build callbacks for user responses.

steps.title: Establish Camera Preview Interface & Callbacks
steps.description: Set up SurfaceHolder callbacks to open, prepare, scale, and release the camera hardware cleanly.

steps.title: Create Screen Aspect Ratio Adjustment System
steps.description: Build an algorithm to parse available camera preview configurations and select the perfect match to prevent preview stretching.

steps.title: Implement Shutter Release and Image Saving Logic
steps.description: Incorporate image capture callback saving JPEG byte-streams directly to the app's external scoped storage system with unique timestamps.

steps.title: Integrate Tap-to-Focus Functionality
steps.description: Implement touch gestures on the preview screen triggering immediate lens autofocus.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Flash & Switch Control Logic
steps.description: Build toggles for toggling between available rear and front cameras, as well as cycling through supported flash states (ON, OFF, AUTO).

steps.title: Build Image Preview, Deletion, and Recovery Features
steps.description: Create in-app image viewer overlay allowing immediate high-res view of captures, photo deletion options, and persistent thumbnail restoring on launch.

steps.title: Building Camera Pro
steps.description: Trigger debug compiler tasks to assemble the native Camera Pro application package.
